name: AI Shopping Auditor
description: Audits Amazon listings for AI shopping visibility, finds unanswered buyer questions, and delivers source-backed listing rewrites.
longDescription:
Evaluate an Amazon listing through the natural-language questions real shoppers ask. The agent builds an evidence-backed product fact base, scores how well each listing surface answers high-intent questions, identifies the most commercially important gaps, and drafts exact source-backed fixes for titles, bullets, A+ content, Q&A, images, and attributes.

This is a visibility and content-readiness audit. It does not access or claim to reproduce Amazon's proprietary ranking, recommendation, Rufus, or Alexa systems.

subAgents.description: Runs source-backed Amazon AI shopping visibility audits and returns prioritized listing fixes.
